name: The vows concerning food (anna-vrata, Taittirīya 3.7-3.10)
method_summary: Four vows: not to disparage food, not to refuse food, to increase food, and not to turn anyone away from one's dwelling (with obtaining much food for that end); not a fasting or diet rule.

name: Worshipping food and breath as brahman (Taittirīya 2.2-2.3)
method_summary: Those who worship food as brahman obtain all food; those who worship breath as brahman reach a full life-span (verses in 2.2.1, 2.3.1); the text gives no further method.

checks.note: Entity read against the teachings it rests on and their segments: faithful; level not raised by J.

name: Seeking brahman by tapas (Bhṛgu and Varuṇa, Taittirīya 3)
method_summary: Varuṇa gives Bhṛgu the mark of brahman (that from which beings are born, live and into which they enter) and tells him to seek it by tapas; Bhṛgu performs tapas and then knows the next identification; the text does not say what the tapas consists of.

checks.note: Entity read against the teachings it rests on and their segments: faithful; level not raised by J.

name: Meditation on brahman under stated aspects (Taittirīya 3.10.2-3.10.4)
method_summary: Meditating on "that" (tat; not named in the passage, the vallī's subject being brahman) as support, as great, as mind, as homage, as brahman, as the "death-around" of brahman, each with its fruit; the text also lists aspects in speech, breath, hands, feet, excretory organ, rain, lightning, cattle, stars, generative organ and space. Summary only.

checks.note: Corrected by J: method_summary: the object "that" (tat) is not named in 3.10.2-3; "brahman" is now marked as the vallī's subject rather than the passage's word.
